newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-EIGHT OF TOP 10 TO PLAY AT MONTE CARLO.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EIGHT OF TOP 10 TO PLAY AT MONTE CARLO.

text.p: Eight of the world's top 10 will take part in the $2.05 million Monte Carlo Open, which celebrates its centenary next month, the organisers said on Thursday.

Americans Pete Sampras, the world number one, and Michael Chang, ranked three, have not entered the April 19-27 clay court event. Three-times winner and title holder Thomas Muster of Austria, ranked two, is top seed, tournament director Bernard Noat told a news conference.
Notable top 20 players taking part include German Boris Becker, finalist three times, American Todd Martin and Albert Costa of Spain, runner-up last year.
Swede Mats Wilander, who won the tournament in 1983 and 1987, has been given a wild card.
